name: signal-noise-showreel
description: SIGNAL / NOISE: a 15-second motion graphics showreel built with Remotion

scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render Showreel out/showreel.mp4
scripts.vosu:render: npm run vosu:audio && remotion render VosuPromo out/vosu-promo.mp4
scripts.arch:render: npm run arch:audio && remotion render ArchFilm out/arch-film.mp4 --gl=swangle
scripts.agent:vo: python3 scripts/vosu/generate_vo.py --model-dir ${KOKORO_DIR:-voices/kokoro} --voice af_heart --lines src/agent/lines.json --out public/agent/vo --meta src/agent/vo.json
scripts.agent:render: npm run agent:audio && remotion render AgentExplainer out/agent-explainer.mp4
